svg.title: Hardware trunk tilt traces for the four push runs
svg.desc: Peak tilt with the policy in control: 24 degrees baseline, 26 and 26 degrees stage1, 32 degrees push plus DR. All stay well below the 60 degree stop threshold; the K1 fall detector read READY throughout.
svg.text: Trunk tilt on hardware while the learned policy had control (IMU, 10 Hz max-pooled)
Baseline (HW3) · deploy3_hw3_run1 · 3 hand pushes · peak 24° · falls 0
Push-trained (stage1) · deploy3_stage1_run1 · 7 hand pushes · peak 26° · falls 0
Push + DR (dr_ramp) · deploy3_dr_ramp_run1 · 4 hand pushes · peak 32° · falls 0
Push-trained (stage1) · deploy3_stage1_run2 · 4 hand pushes · peak 26° · falls 0
dashed: 60° tilt, where the deploy tool stops the policy
